flags.why: The common meaning describing hearty laughter, as in cười nắc nẻ, is missing ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/nac-ne-la-tu-lay-hay-tu-ghep-a175450.html)).
flags.fix: Add as the first meaning: adj | hearty; loud and continuous (of laughter); ex: Em bé cười nắc nẻ. = The baby laughs heartily.

flags.why: This word has a literary register that should be labelled ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-th%C3%AA%20l%C6%B0%C6%A1ng)).
The Vietnamese describes prioritising career success before marriage, whereas the translation asserts that he has already married.
flags.fix: He wants to establish his career first before getting married.
